description: Bornes de Recharge électrique is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by BAH. To find electric charging stations, visit www.borneslib.fr which lists more than 200,000 charging stations in France and Europe. You will find free and paid charging stations, charging rates are displayed on the charging station details. Charging stations are listed by city, by department, by region but also by country. Coverage: BAH. The portal shows the English title as "Electric Recharge Bollards" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is BAH. Its keywords include borne-de-rechargement-electrique, borne-de-recharge-electrique, bornes-de-recharge, borne, reseau-bornes-de-recharge-rapide, bornes-electrique. The listing shows 1 download or service links in XML. The listing shows 2022-09-25 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://opendatacommons.org/licenses/by/summary/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
